checks.name: ui-wide-size
checks.detail: The actual shown application window reaches the wide-layout breakpoint; no display settings, visual reparenting or synthetic layout were used.

checks.name: ui-initial-state
checks.detail: Actual production WPF Overview loaded with unchecked values and zero activity events; no scan command was executed.

checks.name: ui-compact-layout
checks.detail: The actual shown window reaches 980x650 within one DIP; main navigation and inspection action have finite visible bounds. Scrolling/DPI/fidelity still require manual checks.

checks.name: ui-primary-navigation
checks.detail: All five displayed primary sections select the corresponding preserved page through the actual ListBox binding.

checks.name: ui-tool-navigation
checks.detail: All 13 secondary tools select their preserved pages through the actual ComboBox binding without starting inventory. New-module/H1 pages were captured.

checks.name: ui-tool-popup
checks.detail: The real More tools popup opens, and programmatic page changes synchronize both selectors. Physical keyboard and screen-reader interaction are not asserted.

checks.name: duplicate-content-fixtures
checks.detail: Native fixture observations group equal bytes across different names, retain independent identities and exclude a same-size different-content file. Provider state Partial; this is scoped fixture evidence only.

checks.name: duplicate-hardlink-fixture
checks.detail: An actual native hard link shares the original file identity and group and is explicitly labeled an alias, not an independent copy.

checks.name: shortcut-existing-local-fixture
checks.detail: The native fixture returned TargetExists with a reason/source; this is target availability, not proof a shortcut can launch or is obsolete.

checks.name: shortcut-missing-local-fixture
checks.detail: The native fixture returned LocalTargetMissing with a reason/source; this is target availability, not proof a shortcut can launch or is obsolete.

checks.name: shortcut-no-mutation
checks.detail: Both shortcut entries and the existing target remain, and the absent target stays absent. No link or target was launched.

checks.name: diagnostics-metadata-contract
checks.detail: A real local metadata query returned state Available, 7 grouped observation(s) and 4 coverage note(s). No raw event messages/payloads are stored here; zero observations is not a healthy verdict.

checks.name: hardware-metadata-contract
checks.detail: Native H1 state=Partial; projectedFacts=41; sourceClasses=6; pcRecords=1; schemaValid=true; pcSourceComplete=true. This attests the bounded PC source response only, not value accuracy, single-machine identity, supported hardware, manufacturer matching or compatibility. All returned hardware values are withheld.

checks.name: startup-fixture-inventory
checks.detail: The isolated owned HKCU fixture Run/RunOnce names were inventoried. No actual Windows startup source or command was enumerated by this fixture check.

checks.name: startup-fixture-preview
checks.detail: Read-only previews preserve exact REG_SZ/REG_EXPAND_SZ kind and raw NUL-terminated byte count without exposing commands, writing a backup or changing registry data. This is not a disable/restore proof.

checks.name: startup-fixture-mutation-gate
checks.detail: Both mutation APIs remain Unavailable even for a valid fixture preview/explicit request; pre-cancellation reports CancelledBeforeCommit. Source kinds/bytes, journal and files are unchanged. Atomic disable/restore and DPAPI durability remain unverified and unavailable.

checks.name: startup-fixture-scope
checks.detail: The fixture factory rejects a wrong prefix, mismatched ownership GUID and out-of-topology backup directory without creating that directory or modifying owned data. Only isolated current-user fixture sources were used.

checks.name: startup-fixture-teardown
checks.detail: Only the ownership-marked disposable HKCU fixture subtree was removed; actual startup sources were never modified.

checks.name: system-tool-execution-gate
checks.detail: The hard gate rejects an acknowledged dummy repair descriptor with Unavailable/no elevation/no PID. The harness did not Prepare a tool identity, start servicing or request UAC; actual execution remains unverified and disabled.

checks.name: fixture-teardown
checks.detail: Only the owned development fixture tree was removed; no application or personal-file cleanup action was exercised.

limits: Development-only WPF client-content captures and read-only native fixture evidence; no DWM/OS-DPI, exhaustive interaction, servicing, installation, healthy/up-to-date or user-PC verdict.
